description: The user's APP WALLET: whether one exists, its status, its LIVE onchain SOL + USDC, and the next action required. Call this BEFORE explaining why a write was refused — the cause is one of four (no wallet / not activated / revoked / empty float) and each has a different fix. This is NOT the main wallet; it is the address the SERVER signs with on the user's behalf.
name: app_wallet
title: App (operating) wallet — status, live balance, and what to do next
